crew.overview: "One Direction: This Is Us" is a captivating and intimate all-access look at life on the road for the global music phenomenon. Weaved with stunning live concert footage, this inspiring feature film tells the remarkable story of Niall, Zayn, Liam, Harry and Louis' meteoric rise to fame, from their humble hometown beginnings and competing on the X-Factor, to conquering the world and performing at London’s famed O2 Arena. Hear it from the boys themselves and see through their own eyes what it's really like to be One Direction.
crew.title: One Direction: This Is Us

details.biography:
Cori Wapnowska is a documentary filmmaker and editor based in New  York City.  Her first feature documentary, BRUK OUT! premiered to a  sold-out crowd at Sheffield DocFest in 2017, followed by screenings at  the Brooklyn Museum, Alamo Drafthouse, and cinemas worldwide.

Cori has been a member of the Motion Picture Editors Guild since  2012, and was formerly the Editor of HBO's Last Week Tonight with John  Oliver, for which she won a Peabody in 2014.  Her latest project is LATE  HARVEST, a feature documentary about a man struggling to manage a  commune of untrained interns while maintaining his winery business.
details.name: Cori Wapnowska
